releaseNotes: KabirUI 3.0: Full 3D visual overhaul, 10 clock & battery styles, glassmorphic folders, live search, and fluid performance.

changes.title: Major 3.0 Release
changes.detail: KabirUI 3.0 brings a complete UI overhaul, full-screen polish, glassmorphic folders, and fluid animations.

changes.title: 10 Clock & Battery Styles
changes.detail: All 10 handcrafted clock styles and 10 battery meters are restored with height-aware geometry and zero text clipping.

changes.title: Interactive App Drawer
changes.detail: Custom vector glyphs, category icon indicators, and a floating A–Z alphabet scrubber bubble.

changes.title: Live Settings Search
changes.detail: Find any customization option instantly with real-time settings filtering and high contrast support.

changes.title: Glassmorphic Folders & Quick Dock
changes.detail: Redesigned folder surfaces with live app filtering and interactive dock slot editing.
